title: The Outlaw Suite - 10min to Broadway
description:
We set out to create a space that feels unmistakably Nashville. Inspired by the city’s music culture and a story or two.

Inside, you’ll find one of a kind conversation pieces that that celebrate the spirit of Music City. The coffee table is Megan Moroney’s actual road case. There’s even a pool cue snapped in half by Morgan Wallen (true story, I was there).

Minutes away from the best honky-tonks, live music venues, & local hotspots. Walking distance to Fat Bottom Brewery.

The space
Studio guest house
Private Entrance
Queen size bed
65" LG TV
Free parking in driveway or street
Wifi ATT Fiber
Large fenced in backyard with fire pit
Skylight lighting
Kitchenette with coffee bar
Walking distance to a local brewery 
Located in a vibrant neighborhood called The Nations

Guest access
Remote access through smart lock keypad

Other things to note
This stylish guesthouse sits on the same lot as the main home but offers complete privacy with its own separate entrance. Around back is a shared fenced in backyard that is very large for being so close to downtown. You may see our lovely pup, Waylon. He loves guests but we respect your space. There is also a fire pit and creek that runs back there. 

The house is located in a neighborhood called the Nations. This area is one of the fastest growing spots in West Nashville. Filled with coffee shops, breweries and was just named Nashville’s most dog friendly neighborhood.
